stem.text: The second ionisation energy of oxygen is greater than the second ionisation energy of fluorine.

A.text: The atomic radius of an oxygen atom is smaller than that of fluorine.

B.text: The covalent bond in a fluorine molecule is weaker than the bond in an oxygen molecule.

C.text: A spin-paired electron is removed from fluorine but **not** from oxygen.

D.text: Fluorine has more electrons in total than oxygen. This causes a greater shielding of the nuclear attraction in fluorine.
